question: In January 2025, the Gujarat government declared the 'Inland Mangrove of Guneri', located in which district, as its first Biodiversity Heritage Site (BHS)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kutch**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Inland Mangrove of Guneri** is situated in the **Kutch district** of Gujarat.
 
• This site was declared as the **first Biodiversity Heritage Site (BHS)** of Gujarat in **January 2025**.
 
• **Kutch** is known for its unique ecological diversity, including the **Great Rann of Kutch**, which is the world's largest salt desert.
 
• The Inland Mangrove ecosystem of Guneri is a rare phenomenon and represents a **unique biodiversity hotspot**.
 
• It hosts a variety of **flora and fauna**, contributing significantly to the ecological balance in the region.
 
• Under the provisions of the **Biological Diversity Act, 2002**, a Biodiversity Heritage Site is designated to conserve areas with **rich biodiversity** and ecological significance.
 
• The declaration of the Guneri mangrove as a BHS highlights the government’s focus on **environmental conservation** and sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Morbi**__

 __
 
• **Morbi** is a district in Gujarat known for its **ceramic industry**.
 
• The district is famous for its **tile manufacturing** and contributes significantly to the economy of Gujarat.
 
• It is not recognized for inland mangroves or ecological heritage sites.
 
 
 
• **Vadodara**__
 __
 
• **Vadodara**, also known as Baroda, is renowned for its **cultural heritage** and historical significance.
 
• The district is famous for landmarks like **Laxmi Vilas Palace**, rather than ecological zones or mangroves.
 
 
 
• **Rajkot**__
 
 
• **Rajkot** is known for its **industrial and commercial developments**.
 
• The district is not identified for inland mangrove ecosystems or biodiversity heritage sites.
